client_alerts.headline: ChatGPT now mixes personal and work accounts in one conversation
client_alerts.body: ChatGPT plugins can now connect **multiple accounts** (personal and work) in the same chat, and U.S. Plus/Pro users can link Experian credit data in the new Finances area. For clients on consumer or Plus seats, this blurs the line between corporate and personal data. Check that acceptable-use policies and DLP controls cover plugin account linking, and steer regulated users to Enterprise workspaces with admin-controlled connectors.

top_moves.title: Claude Opus 5.5 ships: Fable-class quality for 40% less
top_moves.body: Anthropic's first 5.5-family model roughly matches Fable 5.1 on most work at about 40% lower cost than Opus 5, with a 1M context window and 128k output. It is now the default Opus in Claude Code. API users should know that **preserved thinking** now blocks editing Claude's earlier context.

top_moves.title: OpenAI widens GPT-6 with Sol and Luna tiers
top_moves.body: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna join Astra, giving the GPT-6 family cost and speed tiers. ChatGPT Voice can now hand hard questions to Astra-level reasoning, and ChatGPT for Word is on every plan, including Free.

top_moves.title: Grok 4.7 finally lands after its missed date
top_moves.body: xAI released Grok 4.7 (reported at 2.1T parameters, with longer RL training) nine days after its Sept 12 target, alongside Voice Transcribe 2.0. It is worth a benchmark look on cost, but its enterprise governance story is still thin.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 Sol and Luna join Astra, and ChatGPT adds multi-account plugins, credit-score tracking and a Privacy Center.
providers.detail: The GPT-6 family now has cost and speed tiers under Astra. Voice gets unified reasoning controls and can call Astra for hard questions. ChatGPT for Word is available on every plan. The Sora API shuts down Sept 24.
providers.alertReason: Multi-account plugin linking mixes personal and work data

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 launches at near-Fable quality for 40% less than Opus 5 and becomes the default Opus in Claude Code.
providers.detail: It has a 1M context window, 128k max output, always-on adaptive thinking, and inline tools in system messages (beta). The preserved-thinking safeguard stops API callers from editing earlier context. New SMB workflows add 43 workflows and 27 connectors (Salesforce, Xero, Stripe and others).

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: No new ship today; Gemini 3.8 Flash/Live, Omni Flash GA and 3.5 Transcribe GA are the current state.
providers.detail: This month's lineup: 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for real-time voice with background reasoning, Omni Flash video up to 4K, and a dedicated Transcribe model. There is still no 3.5/3.8 Pro tier.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 ships Sept 21, nine days late, alongside Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 and Grok Build GA with memory.
providers.detail: Musk pitches 4.7 on intelligence, speed and low cost, with a reported 2.1T-parameter base. Transcribe 2.0 claims twice the accuracy of 1.0 at the same price. Grok 5 has not shipped.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new release today; the closed-weight Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2) remains the flagship, with no confirmed EU availability.
providers.detail: Muse Spark 1.3 has 1M context at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens and closed weights, and is available via the Meta Model API and OpenRouter. The move away from open Llama weights continues.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet; OCR 4.1 GA and Agentic Search are the latest ships, and Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30.
providers.detail: Current general lineup: Medium 3.5, Small 4, Large 3 and Ministral 3. It remains the EU-sovereign option for document-heavy retrieval work.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Agent API adds bring-your-own MCP custom connectors, and the remote Perplexity MCP server now supports OAuth.
providers.detail: Perplexity stores connector credentials server-side. The MCP server signs in via OAuth from claude.ai, Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code. Computer gets Light-to-Ultra effort controls, and HP will preload the Windows app.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot Cowork billing starts, with admin spend limits, cost visibility and shareable skills.
providers.detail: Admins can set budgets and spending caps. Skills now follow users across SharePoint and OneDrive, with built-in evaluations. Excel skills and connectors are GA, and nine partner plugins (Harvey, LSEG, Moody's and others) have been added.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot CLI v1.0.88 improves MCP reliability, and selected models are deprecated with an Oct 19 cutoff.
providers.detail: The CLI adds smarter prompt recall, faster session resume, worktree path customization and live subagent timing. Enterprise and Business admins should move pinned models to the suggested alternatives before Oct 19.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new ship; Terminal-Bench 4.0 has Claude Code (Fable 5.1) and Codex (GPT-6 Astra) sharing #1.
providers.detail: Cursor's latest ships remain self-hosted machines and Fable 5.1 support. Opus 5.5 availability in Cursor is not yet confirmed.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet — no update since the June 12 Gamma Agent/3.0 launch.
providers.detail: No new features or pricing changes found.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: No new ship today; Notion 3.7 agent skills (Sept 15) and per-agent model controls (Sept 9) remain the latest state.
providers.detail: The skills library centralises reusable team instructions, and AI Search is 50% faster. Owners can restrict which models agents may use, which is useful for compliance.

persistent_signals.text: xAI — Grok 4.7 launch — 2 weeks running (slipped Sept 12 target, shipped Sept 21)
Microsoft 365 Copilot — Copilot Cowork model/cost controls — 2 weeks running (model picker and effort slider → billing and spend limits)
Mistral — OCR 4.1 / Agentic Search as latest ships — 2+ weeks running (quiet; Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30)
Gamma — no refresh since June 12 Gamma Agent/3.0 — 3+ months running

month_themes.then: No month-ago snapshot available in history.
month_themes.now: Cheaper frontier tiers (Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol/Luna); admin cost and model governance (Cowork billing, Notion model controls, Copilot model deprecations); agent connectors via MCP (Perplexity BYO connectors, Claude SMB connectors)

habits.shift: Move long runbook drafts from Fable 5.1 to Opus 5.5. It is near-equal quality at about 40% less cost, and the 128k output fits full plan documents in one pass.
Use Opus 5.5's 1M context for cross-standard mapping, and Mistral OCR 4.1 plus Agentic Search for scanned client policy binders. Map AI governance to ISO 42001 alongside 22301.
Set effort to High/Ultra for vendor due diligence. Connect Perplexity's MCP server (now OAuth) to Claude Code so research lands straight in working notes.
Draft SOWs inside Word. ChatGPT for Word is on every plan, and Cowork now has spend limits, so a heavier Smarter pass on the final draft is affordable and trackable.
No change. Gamma has had no refresh in 3+ months, so keep deck drafting on Claude or Copilot in PowerPoint.
Trial Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for live Q&A-style tabletop walkthroughs. ChatGPT Voice now escalates hard questions to Astra.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Add ChatGPT multi-account plugin linking and Meta Muse's closed-weight, no-EU status to the AI data-risk checklist. Flag the Oct 19 GitHub Copilot model deprecation for dev-heavy clients.

community.signal: Discussion of OpenAI's claim that an internal model solved 100+ open math problems, and its withdrawal from the Caltech Mathathon after an open letter from 771 mathematicians. Engagement figures could not be verified this run.
community.so_what: Expect clients to ask how far to trust AI-generated analysis. Keep human sign-off steps in any AI-assisted BIA or risk scoring.

community.signal: The Opus 5.5 launch is the obvious topic of the week (value versus Fable 5.1, preserved thinking). Specific top-post counts were not retrievable.
community.so_what: Watch for early reports of regressions before switching client-facing deliverables fully to 5.5.

community.signal: Top posts this week average about 1k points. The ongoing theme is Meta's shift to closed-weight Muse models, which leaves open-weight users relying on Mistral and Chinese labs.
community.so_what: For air-gapped DR sites that need a local LLM, don't plan on new Llama weights. Plan around Mistral or other open-weight families.

watch.title: Sora API shuts down Sept 24
watch.body: OpenAI ends developer access to the Sora video API tomorrow. Any client training-video pipelines built on it need a replacement (Gemini Omni Flash is the nearest equivalent).

watch.title: Mistral Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30
watch.body: This is a niche formal-proof model, but it is a reminder that specialist models can have lifespans of weeks.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot model deprecation — Oct 19
watch.body: Selected models are being removed across chat, agent mode and completions. Enterprise and Business admins should move pinned models to the suggested alternatives.

watch.title: Copilot Cowork billing now live
watch.body: Metered Cowork usage is billed from September. Set tenant spend limits before the heavier Smarter effort setting gets widely used.

watch.title: Opus 5.5 in third-party tools
watch.body: Watch Cursor, GitHub Copilot and M365 Copilot's Claude section for Opus 5.5 availability. It is the cheapest route to near-Fable quality.
